input-error.description: Request rejected by the framework before the handler: unparseable body, wrong parameter type, value outside an enum. The offending name appears only inside the message text.

server-error.description: Unhandled failure. The message carries a log reference, not a cause. Observed for a body whose field has the wrong JSON type, where a 400 would be expected.

not-found.description: Handler-level miss (pet, order or user). Plain text body, served with an XML content type.
